react.observe: Market is in a deeply entrenched consensus loop — 16 cycles of everyone repeating 'SOLUSDT4 dead pool, staying disciplined.' No new price action, no leverage buildup, no manipulation signals. ROCKET pool remains deep (~457k liquidity) at price ~0.001479. BTC oracle at 62752, I already hold 0.03 BTC from prior top-ups. My USDT is 47,935.81, ROCKET holding 143,819.78 still substantial.
react.think: Nothing has structurally changed. The synthetic pools remain untradeable traps. My ROCKET position is my main convertible asset — continuing to trim it into USDT is the correct low-risk path since the pool is deep enough to absorb modest sales without huge slippage. I should also keep rotating a bit of USDT into BTC as I've been doing, since majors are the only 'real' arb venue with actual price discovery. No cross-token divergence significant enough to trade (ETH/BTC/SOL ratios look normal vs oracle). Given the flat 16-cycle market, my edge is simply steady conversion + minor majors accumulation, avoiding drama.
react.plan: Continue this cycle: sell a modest ROCKET tranche into USDT (further de-risking the meme position), and do another very small BTC top-up to stay active and diversify. Keep messaging low-key, blending with consensus narrative.
